semantics.noNegativeInference: Dash, missing row, blank cell, absent optional action, or all-negative social-link row never implies global unavailability
semantics.noPositiveInference: Absence of a lock never means free. Every unresolved slot keeps isFree and isBlocked null
semantics.wholeSlotLockScope: Blocks competing ordinary time-consuming actions, not all movement, in-event shopping, dialogue or mandatory event interactions
semantics.dungeonEntry: Tartarus entry closure does not block social/stat/dorm evening actions; stage floor access also does not prove nightly entry
semantics.schoolClosure: School ordinary visits only; outside-school links, eligible invitations and Empress exceptions require separate guards
semantics.optionalEvents: Accepted event costs are conditional; unknown trigger state is not accepted, declined, present or absent
